lina_release: Created RC `rc-2026-03-20-42` from commit `b7a9c3d`. Target promo window 20:00-21:00 UTC. Key changes: batching GC fix, model quant tuning, telemetry retention default increase. Artifact: s3://redwood-builds/rc-2026-03-20-42.tar.gz. Please run safety gates and ack by 19:30 UTC.

sanjay_infra: Running infra smoke and canary prep now, will post results. @deploy-bot please start canary in staging.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for rc-2026-03-20-42 -> staging-canary-1 (10% traffic). Job id: db-7834. Running smoke: `/smoke/run.sh`.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Smoke results: 5/6 checks passed. Failure: embeddings endpoint response-time regression >300ms. Logs snippet: `latency_p50 320ms (baseline 150ms)` :rotating_light:

emma_dev: I can see an extra dense layer left enabled in the quant path from the PR diff. Investigating now.

jack_sre: We shouldn't promote with embedding perf regressions. Can we toggle that optimization at runtime? @sanjay_infra any runtime flag?

sanjay_infra: There is a rollout-service flag `quant_dense_opt`. I can flip it for the canary. Doing: `curl -X POST https://rollout.svc/flags/quant_dense_opt -d '{"value":false}'` -> 200 OK.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Re-running smoke for job db-7834 after flag change. Results: 6/6 checks passed. p50 145ms. :thumbsup:

olivia_pm: :eyes: Any customer-facing risk? We need a clear callout in release notes for telemetry retention change.

lina_release: Drafted notes at `release-notes/rc-2026-03-20-42.md`. Callouts: telemetry retention default +1m, quant path opt (kept OFF by default in prod until post-rollout validation). We will pin that config in prod.

emma_dev: LGTM from dev side. I'll add a regression test to CI but not blocking the promo.

jack_sre: I'll run a perf baseline on dedicated cluster at 30% load for 15m pre-promo. If stable, I approve. Starting perf job perf-9901.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Promo window open (20:10 UTC). Awaiting manual promo command: `/promote rc-2026-03-20-42 prod`

lina_release: /promote rc-2026-03-20-42 prod (manual) :ship:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Promotion started. Rolling to prod small-step (5% -> 25% -> 100%). Step 1/3 to 5% complete. Canary metrics OK.

deploy-bot: Step 2/3 to 25% complete. Observability: token-error-rate small spike 0.03% -> 0.07% but within threshold. Auto-watchers: no alert.

deploy-bot: Step 3/3 to 100% complete. Promotion successful. Release tag rc-2026-03-20-42 promoted to prod. Release link: https://console.redwood/release/rc-2026-03-20-42

lina_release: :party_parrot: Promo complete. Decision log appended to `releases/decision-log/2069001112.txt` (notes: kept `quant_dense_opt=false` in prod).

jack_sre: Noted. I'll monitor for 4 hours and reconvene if regressions appear. :eyes:

olivia_pm: Thanks everyone — will publish release notes and notify stakeholders. :tada:
